title: Slower to use than Apple Cal
body:
Why I reverted to Apple calendar.
I use the Google Calendar on my PC and have a quite a few set up for different groups and tasks. So I thought the app would be perfect for my iPhone. 

I prefer its brighter colours (not interested in the schedule or pretty images though) and the options for views. 

But there’s a major pain point with the Google calendar iOS app and that’s the lack of shortcuts to do typical tasks such as deleting an event or changing its finish time or duration.

In the Apple calendar, deleting an event is as simple as opening it and hitting delete. In the Google calendar you have to open it, then go to settings then delete it.

Revising events in the Google app is even more clunky. To change the start or finish time while leaving the other as is- lengthening or shortening and event- in Apple calendar, it’s as simple as highlighting the event and then dragging the start or finish time handles to where you want them. There is no equivalent operation with Google, once again you have to open the app and then go to individual time settings and change these. 

Much as I love and prefer the look of the Google calendar all these extra clicks are a dealbreaker for me when I just want to quickly deal with an event. Once they’re available I’ll be back to it but for now I’m sticking with Apple.

title: Best autosyncing calendar app out!!

Because we update meeting rooms from desktop and/or device, we need an app that can update automatically. We want to use this in our workplace, only issues are: it can’t be viewed in landscape mode, and, it is not searchable in iPad. I've had to copy the link from desktop, send the link to my inbox, open the link on iPad and download the long way. 

Pleease change the viewing options and open the app to iPad. This will be the biggest lifesaver!!! :)
